skills.name: Decolonisation case study: Nigeria’s negotiated transition

note.text: Nigeria’s transition involved nationalist parties, regional interests, constitutional conferences and federal arrangements under British rule. A federal framework allocated authority between central and regional institutions; it did not mean that all political interests became identical. The federal election of 1959 preceded independence on 1 October 1960. Abubakar Tafawa Balewa headed the federal government at independence. Later instability should not be read backward as proof that constitutional negotiation had no meaning or that conflict was inevitable.

sections.heading: Your goal and connections
sections.text: By the end, you should be able to explain how federal arrangements and political negotiation shaped Nigeria’s independence. Builds on: Ghana’s constitutional route and the distinction between autonomy and sovereignty. Leads to: French West Africa and comparison of varied transitions.

sections.heading: Explain the history

sections.heading: Follow the evidence and examples
sections.text: Federal arrangements developed during the {1950}s. The {1958} constitutional conference set out a path toward independence, followed by the {1959} election and parliamentary steps. Independence changed Nigeria’s status while questions of regional balance and political inclusion remained. Compare the mechanism with Ghana without assuming identical parties, dates or constitutional structures.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Identify actor, action, place and period before explaining a relationship. Use the practice text only for the claim it supports. Distinguish a cause, an event and an outcome; compare authentic sources before treating an interpretation as established. A sequence alone does not prove that every later outcome was inevitable.

cards.idea: Check a claim against the sequence, setting and limits of the evidence.
example: A federation means regions have no institutions or powers. Correction: Federal arrangements allocate authority across levels.

Nigeria’s {1960} independence preceded Ghana’s {1957} independence. Correction: The dated sequence gives the opposite order.
Independence guaranteed the permanent disappearance of political disagreement. Correction: A change of status does not resolve every institutional issue.
